text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan calls for a "wider concept of European-Mediterranean cooperation that includes the Gulf states".
- King Hussein discusses the negotiations on the Palestinian front with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher.
- Italian rice granted to Jordan as assistance from the EU.
- 3,500 Jordanians perform Friday prayers close to the Israeli trade fair in protest over the holding of the exhibition.
- A limited ministerial reshuffle possible during Ramadan, which should not preclude the cabinet reshuffle expected next April.
- Opponents of Israeli trade exhibition protest against event with prayers.
